privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.updated: Hoshi Club, published by Hoshi Technologies. Last updated: {date}.
privacy.intro: Hoshi Club (“the app”) lets Shopify merchants offer a loyalty program to their customers. This policy explains what data the app processes, why and how.

store.label: Store data:
store.text: store domain and access tokens provided by Shopify at installation.

members.label: Member data:
members.text: Shopify customer ID, first name, last name, email address, number of orders, points balance and history, loyalty tier, discount codes earned, birthday (day and month, if the customer provides it) and referral code.

referrals.label: Referral data:
referrals.text: email address entered by the invited person to receive their welcome code.

orders.label: Order data:
orders.text: ID, subtotal and total of paid orders and discount codes used, only to calculate points.

privacy.noPayment: The app collects no payment data and uses no advertising cookies.
privacy.use: Data is used only to run the store's loyalty program: calculating and showing points, assigning tiers and their perks, creating discount codes, managing referrals and showing statistics to the merchant. It is never sold, rented or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.hosting: Data is hosted by Cloudflare (Cloudflare Workers and D1). Shopify provides store and customer data through its APIs. These providers act as processors and apply their own security safeguards.

retention.installed: Data is kept for as long as the app is installed.
retention.customerRedact: When a customer asks (through Shopify), their data is deleted automatically (customers/redact webhook).
retention.shopRedact: 48 hours after uninstalling, Shopify requests deletion of the store's data; all of it is then erased (shop/redact webhook).
retention.merchant: The merchant can remove a customer from the program at any time from the app.

privacy.rights: Under the GDPR and similar laws, customers have the right to access, correct, delete and object to the processing of their data. They can exercise these rights with the store concerned (the data controller) or by writing to us. Access requests sent by Shopify (customers/data_request webhook) are handled.

support.title: Help and contact
support.intro: A question or a problem? Write to us, we reply within 2 business days:

widget.q: How do I show the program on my store?
widget.a: In Shopify: Online Store → Themes → Customize → App embeds, then turn on “Hoshi Club”. The app's dashboard has a direct link.

points.q: When do my customers get their points?
points.a: Automatically as soon as the order is paid. Points are removed if the order is refunded.

tierDiscounts.a: Each tier adds a tag to the customer and creates a Shopify automatic discount reserved for customers in that tier. It applies at checkout, with no code. You can see the discounts in Shopify → Discounts.

assignTier.q: Can I assign a tier to a specific customer?
assignTier.a: Yes: Members → Add a customer, or from a member's page (“Customer tier” section).

referrals.a: Each member has a personal link. The invited friend enters their email and receives a welcome code; the referrer earns points when that code is used in a paid order.

languages.a: The app follows the language of your Shopify admin and the widget follows your store's language, in 36 languages. Reward names left empty are translated automatically.

uninstall.q: What happens if I uninstall the app?
uninstall.a: Automatic discounts stay in Shopify until you delete them. Program data is erased 48 hours after uninstalling.
